entities.summary: Kamil Adrian Majchrzak is a Polish professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 53 achieved on 30 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 241 achieved on 8 August 2016. He is currently the No. 1 singles player from Poland.
